claim_boundary: Q1-only projection reference with discarded one-focal-user immediate counterfactuals; not a trained R1-only arm, composability test, or deployable oracle
common_random_number_contract: all alternatives use evaluate_actions from the same pre-decision state and a clone of the same environment RNG; only the Q1 projection commits
independent_unit: evaluation seed; user-step rows are clustered
mode: evaluation-only; no optimizer, replay, reward, or training update
sampling: data-blind without-replacement draws from all user IDs before role eligibility; no replacement draws for ineligible users
